Cheile sunt greșite sau nu au voie să fo: The keys are wrong or are not allowed to use the bucket ({code}).
Regiunea sau adresa nu se potrivesc cu b: The region or the address does not match the bucket ({code}).
Merge cu AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaz: Works with AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO and DigitalOcean Spaces. Create a bucket and an access key that can read and write only that bucket, then paste the address (endpoint), the region (for R2: auto) and the keys.
Calea trebuie să fie completă, începând: The path must be a full path, starting from the drive or its root.
Pick a folder, not the root of a drive.
«{file}» din folder nu e un fișier obișn: "{file}" in the folder is not a regular file.
Calea completă a unui folder existent. A: The full path of an existing folder. Pick one in iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive for desktop, on a NAS or on a USB stick, and the backup gets there through their sync. Example: C:\Users\you\iCloudDrive\Jolty
